supplements.label: Why Wake?
supplements.prompt: Why have you decided to apply to Wake Forest? Share with us anything that has made you interested in our institution.

supplements.label: Optional written supplement (choose one of four): Books
supplements.prompt: List five books you've read that have intrigued you. (150 character limit per book title)

supplements.label: Optional written supplement (choose one of four): Intellectual curiosity
supplements.prompt: Tell us what piques your intellectual curiosity or has helped you understand the world's complexity. This can include a work you've read, a project you've completed for a class, and even co-curricular activities in which you have been involved.

supplements.label: Optional written supplement (choose one of four): Maya Angelou
supplements.prompt: Dr. Maya Angelou, renowned author, poet, civil-rights activist, and former Wake Forest University Reynolds Professor of American Studies, inspired others to celebrate their identities and to honor each person's dignity. Choose one of Dr. Angelou's powerful quotes. How does this quote relate to your lived experience or reflect how you plan to contribute to the Wake Forest community?

supplements.label: Optional written supplement (choose one of four): Top Ten List
supplements.prompt: Give us your Top Ten List. (The choice of theme is yours.) (100 character limit per line)
